controlChangeCommands.name: Bank MSB
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls. Values 0–7. Pair with CC32 (setlist) / PC for bank addressing; Storm Summoner x_pc covers one setlist (128 presets).

controlChangeCommands.name: EXP 1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates EXP 1 pedal. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Pedal and Footswitch Assignments.

controlChangeCommands.name: EXP 2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates EXP 2 pedal. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Pedal and Footswitch Assignments.

controlChangeCommands.name: EXP 3
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates EXP 3 pedal. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Pedal and Footswitch Assignments.

controlChangeCommands.name: Setlist
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Bank LSB — setlist select (0–7 = Setlists 1–8). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC / Setlist menu helper text (CC32).

controlChangeCommands.name: FS1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS1. CC49–59 follow Stomp/Preset/Snapshot footswitch mode. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC.

controlChangeCommands.name: FS2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS2. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Pedal and Footswitch Assignments.

controlChangeCommands.name: FS7
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS7 (no FS6 — MODE is CC71). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC.

controlChangeCommands.name: FS8
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates FS8. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Pedal and Footswitch Assignments.

controlChangeCommands.name: EXP Toe Sw
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Emulates EXP toe switch. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Pedal and Footswitch Assignments.

controlChangeCommands.name: Rec/Overdub
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Looper Record/Overdub (FS8). 0–63 Overdub; 64–127 Record. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Looper Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Play/Stop
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Looper Play/Stop (FS9). 0–63 Stop; 64–127 Play. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Looper Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Play Once
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Looper Play Once (FS3). Values 64–127. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Looper Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Undo/Redo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Looper Undo/Redo (FS2). Values 64–127. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Looper Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Tap Tempo
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Tap Tempo. Values 64–127. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Fwd/Reverse
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Looper Forward/Reverse (FS11). 0–63 Forward; 64–127 Reverse. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Looper Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Full/Half
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Looper Full/Half Speed (FS10). 0–63 Full; 64–127 Half. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Looper Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Loop On/Off
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Looper block on/off; also enters/exits Looper footswitch mode. 0–63 Off; 64–127 On. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Looper Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Tuner
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Tuner screen on/off. Manual lists 0–127 without value bands; Off/On extremes used. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Snapshot
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: 0–7 = Snapshot 1–8; 8 = Next; 9 = Previous. Snapshot CC auto-send optional in Global Settings > MIDI/Tempo. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Mode Switch
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Engages the MODE switch. Values 0–127. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Preset ±
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Previous/Next preset. 0–63 Previous; 64–127 Next. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Prm Knob 1
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 1 (global control of currently displayed knob). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls. Not a fixed per-block parameter map.

controlChangeCommands.name: Prm Knob 2
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 2 (global). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Prm Knob 3
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 3 (global). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Prm Knob 4
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 4 (global). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Prm Knob 5
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 5 (global). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Prm Knob 6
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Parameter Knob 6 (global). Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.

controlChangeCommands.name: Page L/R
controlChangeCommands.additionalInfo: Page Left/Right buttons. 0–63 Page Left; 64–127 Page Right. Helix 3.80 Owner's Manual MIDI CC Additional Controls.
